review_candidates.description: MadeByOne is a Malta-based company offering specialised B2B services for the iGaming, Fintech and Finance industries. Built on veteran industry expertise, we deliver data-driven solutions that help fast-paced businesses scale. Despite our startup spirit, we bring deep operational knowledge to help our partners navigate complex markets and drive sustainable growth. Unlock your full potential as a Head of Marketing - LATAM . MadeByOne is a B2B services company, recruiting on behalf of our partners. In this unique B2B role, you will own growth strategy for a partner's LATAM market, beginning with Brazil. You will set clear KPIs across acquisition and retention, lead work across CRM, content, affiliates, influencers and design, and control performance and budget for the region. You won't just be overseeing channels; you will connect LATAM marketing with the partner's central and global teams, and keep regional expansion on track. If you have a data-driven mindset, strong leadership skills and a passion for scaling markets in Latin America, we would love to hear from you! This is a remote role, open to candidates based anywhere in Latin America. What we want you to do: Strategy & Regional Ownership: Define and implement growth strategies tailored to the partner's LATAM market, beginning with Brazil. Set clear KPIs across acquisition and retention channels, including first-time conversions (FTDs), ROI, CAC and registration-to-conversion rate. Own regional expansion planning, including market research and channel readiness for new countries. CRM: Approve lifecycle marketing plans, promotional and reward mechanics, and account segmentation strategies for the partner's LATAM market. Content: Oversee content direction to ensure brand consistency and localisation relevance across the region. Affiliates: Supervise affiliate pipeline management, performance KPIs, volume caps (CAPs) and commission frameworks. Influencers: Direct influencer selection, campaign planning, deliverables tracking and budget approvals. Design: Manage creative request prioritisation, and review final assets for promotions and campaigns. Performance & Budget Control: Monitor cross-channel performance reports, ensuring traffic and conversion goals are met. Manage marketing budgets for LATAM initiatives, allocating spend effectively across channels. Lead monthly and quarterly performance reviews, with strategic adjustments based on insights. Stakeholder Collaboration: Act as the main point of contact between LATAM marketing functions and the partner's central and global teams, including CRM, Product, Legal, Compliance and VIP. Ensure smooth alignment between operational teams and senior management on marketing objectives. Requirements Marketing leadership: Proven experience leading marketing for a country, region or brand, including growth strategy and several acquisition and retention channels. Experience in the iGaming industry, or in another regulated market, is required. LATAM and Brazil: Hands-on marketing experience in Latin America, ideally including Brazil. Languages: Professional proficiency in written and spoken English is required. Professional proficiency in Portuguese and/or Spanish is also required, with Portuguese particularly valuable for work focused on Brazil. Performance and budget: Experience setting channel KPIs, owning marketing budgets and leading monthly or quarterly performance reviews. Channel leadership: Experience coordinating or leading work across several of the following: CRM, content, affiliates, influencers and design. Stakeholder collaboration: A clear track record of working with central or global teams and keeping operational teams aligned with senior management on marketing objectives. Advantage: An existing professional network in Brazil or the wider LATAM market, or experience preparing a new country in the region for launch, would be an advantage.
